subject: MAP Draft & Pricing Approval - StellarSys (Target close: 2026-04-15)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Allison Park <apark@stellarsys.com>, John Murray <john.murray@stellarsys.com>
Cc: dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 24 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: StellarSys MAP draft + pricing (post-call)

Hi Allison / John -

Great conversation today - thanks for the time. Per our discovery call I put together a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that captures the milestones, owners, dependencies, and a proposed target close date. High-level summary below and draft attached.

Key milestones (draft):
- POC kickoff / integration readiness (owner: StellarSys engineering) - target: 2026-03-31
- API integration & test (owner: StellarSys + Redwood SE (Dylan)) - target: 2026-04-07
- Performance review & cost-sizing (owner: Redwood Solutions) - target: 2026-04-09
- Exec review & procurement approval (owner: StellarSys execs + Redwood sales) - target: 2026-04-12
- Contract signature / SOW / kick-off (owner: StellarSys procurement + Redwood legal) - target close: 2026-04-15

Dependencies called out in the MAP: procurement timeline, SOC 2 evidence review (we can provide), and confirmation of commit level (12 vs 24 months) to finalize pricing.

Attachments: StellarSys_MAP_Draft_v1.pdf (Drive link included below) and a pricing worksheet (high level, draft).

Next steps I propose:
1) Please review the MAP and confirm owners/targets - if you prefer a different close date, flag it.
2) If pricing looks like it will need exec review, please confirm now so I can escalate internally.
3) I'll circulate an exec-ready pricing summary if you indicate you need approval for a discount/credits.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdMAPdraft

Thanks - happy to hop on a short follow-up call if helpful.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0142

From: Allison Park <apark@stellarsys.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, John Murray <john.murray@stellarsys.com>
Cc: procurement@stellarsys.com
Date: Tue, 24 Mar 2026 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: StellarSys MAP draft + pricing (post-call)

Thanks Marissa - good wrap. A few quick items from our side:

- Procurement is on the thread (procurement@stellarsys.com) - they will need the pricing worksheet and any standard terms redlines.
- Exec review: I'll need a short exec summary showing list price, proposed discount, and any credits. Our finance lead wants to see the committed ARR level that maps to those discounts.
- Target close: 2026-04-15 is aggressive but achievable if procurement has the worksheet this week and execs see the summary by next Tuesday.

Can you send an exec-ready pricing summary (1-pager) + updated MAP that indicates the responsibilities explicitly? Also confirm whether the discounts you anticipate require a separate approval path.

Allison
Allison Park
VP Product Operations, StellarSys
apark@stellarsys.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com, dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: StellarSys MAP draft + pricing (exec summary request)

Rishi / Dylan -

Forwarding Allison's note. They asked for an exec-ready pricing summary and confirmation on discount approval path. Quick context: expected ARR commit is likely to be in the $350k-$450k range depending on term (12 vs 24 months). My proposed pricing asks:

- Base list price
- Proposed discount: 10% standard for AE-managed deals; 15% requires manager/RevOps approval; anything >20% is exec-level SKU and needs CRO signoff.
- One-time onboarding credit request: $20k applied to first invoice if they sign a 12-month commit (we think this accelerates close).

Attachments: StellarSys_pricing_worksheet.xlsx (draft) - includes tiered pricing by commit (12/24).

Can you advise on whether the 15% + $20k credit is OK to request for approval? If yes, I'll ask for an exec review and loop in Vivek.

Thanks - Marissa

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 26 Mar 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: StellarSys MAP draft + pricing (exec summary request)

Marissa -

Thanks for the context and pricing worksheet. Initial read: 10% aligns with quota guidance; 15% is okay but needs manager signoff (Vivek) given the ARR band you expect and the one-time credit. A few notes:

- Please confirm committed ARR number (estimate floor and upside) in the 1-pager so we can justify the 15% + $20k credit to finance.
- Confirm whether the onboarding credit is refundable or applied as invoice credit (finance prefers invoiced credit).
- If they ask for 24-month pricing we can tighten the discount and reduce credits.

I'll loop in Vivek for approval on the 15% + $20k conditional on the commit details.

-Rishi
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com, dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 27 Mar 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: StellarSys MAP draft + pricing (exec summary request)

Marissa / team -

I reviewed the worksheet and the projected ARR band. Approve the following for the StellarSys pursuit:

- Discount: 15% off list (finalized at contract signature)
- One-time onboarding credit: $20,000 applied to first invoice (finance to process as invoice credit)
- Conditions: 12-month minimum commitment and signed SOW/contract by 2026-04-15. If they choose 24-months, reduce credit to $10k and we can consider a slightly better host pricing cadence.

Marissa: please update the MAP to reflect the approved discount/credit and the condition language. Also prepare a 1-page exec summary with committed ARR estimate and the approval ask, and send it to Allison+procurement. I'll be copied and will confirm if finance/legal need additional artifacts.

Vivek
VP, Revenue | Redwood Inference
